status: Specification only; consumer/shader implementation belongs to Claude and is still required. No macro/base wear is baked into these candidates.

inputs.slot: Model material slot; hard gate every mask to its intended part
inputs.sourceStation: Authored horizontal path station in metres. Do not substitute swept UV.u: the adapter defines that as physical 3D edge distance, differing on grades and turns.
inputs.faceNormal: Geometry face normal; preserve cap/chamfer distinction
inputs.supportBottom: detail.supports[].bottom for the owning pier, not global world zero
inputs.edgeDistanceOrFaceTag: Actual cap/chamfer/edge identity for edge wear; not distance to a repeat-tile border

implementationConstraint: Bind source ownership/support metadata with the instance or vertices; do not search every support/joint every frame. The existing generated geometry/adapter is source authority.

masks.name: pier-base-contact
masks.verticalFaceGate: 1 - smoothstep(0.35, 0.70, abs(normal.y)); horizontal cap faces excluded
masks.response: Stable irregular dirt/splash concentrated near true base: up to ~15% local albedo darkening, roughness increases ~0.05–0.10; optional small damp core decreases roughness locally. Never lower the whole shaft brightness.
masks.height: No broad height displacement from dirt
masks.forbidden: No repeating 0.6 m band in UV/image space; no global worldY cutoff; do not stain every horizontal cap.

masks.name: barrier-lower-splash
masks.response: Weak irregular road-side lower splash; keep top mostly dry. Tune from actual render, preserve source concrete response.
masks.forbidden: No lane-line/gutter UV changes; do not treat uv.v modulo tile height as barrier height.

masks.name: barrier-cap-use
masks.response: A slightly smoother cap, roughness reduced by at most ~0.08; small restrained edge marks. Real bevel geometry supplies silhouette/highlight.
masks.forbidden: Do not sprinkle chips over every planar face or invent a baked bevel at tile boundaries.

masks.name: soffit-joint-deposit
masks.response: Broad low-contrast deposit or a little retained moisture close to real joint/contact paths; roughly +/-0.06 roughness modulation, modest <=12% colour change. Avoid black joints on every texture repeat.
masks.forbidden: No long vertical rain stripes painted across a downward horizontal underside.
masks.emptyJointList: Return zero coverage when the structure has no authored joints.

masks.name: web-fascia-runoff
masks.response: Restrained vertical runoff below an actual joint/drip edge. Direction follows gravity on upright webs/fascia; it does not follow a texture rotation.
masks.forbidden: No arbitrary full-surface streak curtain, no borrowed wall-base shader with global height zero.

combination: Start from authored maps. Use bounded coverage/mix, not repeated multiplicative wetness. Keep masks separated by slot and face orientation; dirt is not AO and does not change silhouette.
validation: Two pier heights and two different support.bottom elevations: only lower ~0.6 m weathers. A jointed soffit and midspan should differ by station; vertical fascia runoff and horizontal underside deposits must remain directionally distinct. Compare masks on/off at fixed light/exposure/camera.
